project_type: Django monolith — single-app Python/Django backend, Jinja2-style Django templates, vanilla JS frontend
build_system: Django manage.py — no separate build step for JS/CSS (static files served directly from static/)
test_framework: Django TestCase (unittest-based) — tests live in apps/<app>/tests.py
verification_instructions: 1. Run `python manage.py check` — must exit 0. 2. Run `python manage.py test apps.orders --verbosity=2` — all tests must pass. 3. Run `python manage.py test apps.kitchen --verbosity=2` — all tests must pass.
snapshot_or_generated_files: staticfiles/ is a collectstatic output directory — do NOT edit files there. Always edit files in static/ (source). The staticfiles/ copies are not checked in for deployment; they are regenerated by `python manage.py collectstatic`.
environment_constraints: manage.py is at the workspace root: c:\Users\Shecile\kape_de_manubag_system\manage.py. Run all Python commands from that directory. Windows PowerShell environment.
contribution_requirements: Edit source files only (static/, templates/, apps/). Never edit files under staticfiles/ or venv/. No new migrations needed (Order.notes already exists as TextField blank=True).
key_patterns: POS JS object is `window.POS` defined as an object literal in static/js/main.js starting around line 700. It has methods: addItem, removeItem, changeQty, render, _draftPayload, saveDraft, clearDraft, initDraftPersistence, restoreDraft, submitOrder. The POS submits orders via fetch() POST with Content-Type: application/json. The backend endpoint is create_pos_order in apps/orders/views.py. Notes field on Order model is `notes = models.TextField(blank=True)` with no max_length. The POS template uses inline styles consistent with font-size:0.82rem and padding:6px 10px for controls. Draft persistence uses sessionStorage keyed by POS._DRAFT_KEY.
directory_structure: apps/ — Django apps (orders, kitchen, menu, accounts, etc.); templates/ — all HTML templates organized by app name; static/js/ — source JavaScript (main.js is the only JS file); staticfiles/ — DO NOT EDIT, collectstatic output; manage.py — at workspace root
